videos.title: Scary Godparents
videos.overview: Timmy is annoyed when Vicky has to come over so he wishes she could end up millions of miles away. So Cosmo goes to Yugopotamia, on Mark's birthday and tricks him into coming for Vicky. But when Plan B for what to do with Timmy requires sending him to some wierd kindness and happiness (and boringness) place, Timmy must accept Mark's challenge for Vicky.
